cases.sentence: О, если бы голова моя была ___,
cases.explain: «водным потоком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

cases.explain: «коварного народа» — after the preposition «среди», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says Yahweh.

cases.explain: «гибельная стрела» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart, he waits to ambush him.

cases.sentence: Поэтому, так говорит Господь Сил, Бог Израиля: Я накормлю этот народ ___ и напою отравленной водой.
cases.explain: «горькой пищей» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
